lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 할 말이 있다고 했죠?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, you said you had something to tell me?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, hal mari itdago haetjyo?
lines.learner: 지수 씨, 우리 집안일을 나눠서 해요.
lines.roman: Jisu ssi, uri jibannireul nanwoseo haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Sure. The house has gotten a bit dirty lately, right?
lines.en: Yes, the rooms got messy. We need to tidy up.

lines.beaver_en: Then what should we do first?
lines.en: I'll empty the wastebasket and clean the sofa.

lines.learner: 소파 밑도 제가 할게요. 먼지가 많아졌어요.
lines.en: I'll do under the sofa too. There's a lot more dust.
lines.roman: Sopa mitdo jega halkkeyo. Meonjiga manajyeosseoyo.

lines.learner: 고마워요. 세탁할 때 이불도 빨아 줄 수 있어요?
lines.en: Thanks. Can you wash the blanket too when you do laundry?
lines.roman: Gomawoyo. Setakal ttae ibuldo ppara jul su isseoyo?

lines.beaver_en: Sure, the weather's nice, so I'll wash it this weekend.
lines.en: We're short on hangers too. I'll buy new ones.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Who will wipe the window glass?
lines.learner: 유리는 제가 닦을게요. 창문이 깨끗해질 거예요.
lines.en: I'll wipe the glass. The windows will get clean.
lines.roman: Yurineun jega dakkeulkkeyo. Changmuni kkaekkeutaejil geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: The living room lamp has gotten a bit weak too.
lines.en: Right. The living room got dark. Let's change the lamp.

lines.beaver_en: Then the house will get really clean.
lines.en: Yes, splitting the housework makes me feel better.
Okay, I'll empty the wastebasket right now.
